description: We are Team Krushang from Pune, India. Led by Krushang (9 yrs) with parent support. Our mission: Create a Junior Astronaut Training Story about ISS - Abandoned but Not Forgotten. We focus on Best Use of Storytelling Award. We use NASA open data to teach kids about mission trade-offs through story, art & simple game concept. Skills: Storytelling, Research, Presentation.d
